issues.description: The script uses XMLHttpRequest to fetch external code and executes it via a[a][a](x.responseText), which is equivalent to eval(). This is a remote code execution vulnerability.
issues.recommendation: Remove dynamic code loading and execution. Only load trusted, versioned scripts via @require.

issues.description: The script executes code using eval-like construct (a[a][a]), which is equivalent to eval().
issues.recommendation: Avoid using eval or similar constructs. Use safe, static code.

issues.description: The script loads modules from arbitrary URLs via XMLHttpRequest, which can be abused for supply chain attacks.
issues.recommendation: Restrict module loading to trusted, versioned sources.

issues.description: The script uses innerHTML and removes elements, but also allows dynamic code execution from external sources, which can lead to DOM XSS.
issues.recommendation: Sanitize all inputs and avoid executing code from untrusted sources.

issues.description: The script uses GM.getValue and GM.setValue to store and retrieve user data (count, id), which could be used for tracking.
issues.recommendation: Clarify what data is stored and why. Avoid persistent identifiers unless necessary.

issues.description: The script requests high privileges (@grant unsafeWindow, GM_getTabs, GM_saveTab, etc.), some of which may not be used or are excessive.
issues.recommendation: Reduce privilege scope to only what is needed.

issues.description: The script loads third-party libraries from GreasyFork and jQuery from CDN, but does not pin versions with hashes.
issues.recommendation: Pin dependencies to specific versions and use hashes if possible.

issues.description: The script uses a code obfuscation technique (a[a][a]) to execute code, which makes auditing difficult.
issues.recommendation: Remove obfuscation and use clear, readable code.

issues.description: The script creates hidden iframes and manipulates frame contexts, which may be used for clickjacking or data extraction.
issues.recommendation: Avoid unnecessary iframe manipulation unless required for functionality.

details: Persistent unique identifier (uuidv4) stored via GM.setValue

summary: This userscript presents critical security risks, including remote code execution via dynamic external code loading and eval-like constructs, code obfuscation, DOM XSS potential, excessive privilege requests, privacy collection (persistent identifiers), and supply chain risks. It is not safe for use in its current form.
